environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a shared VPC. The S3 bucket 'tenant-uploads' has public read access enabled via bucket policy for a CDN origin. The PostgreSQL RDS instance uses a single database role 'app_user' with RLS policies defined but the role has 'BYPASSRLS' privilege due to a migration oversight. The task IAM role has s3:PutObject without condition keys restricting content types or object size. No API Gateway or ALB with content inspection sits in front of the service - traffic arrives directly via NLB on port 8080.

config.s3_bucket_policy: public-read for cdn origin, no content-type conditions
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 8080
